```python
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def task_func(df1, df2, column1="feature1", column2="feature2"):
    if "id" not in df1.columns or "id" not in df2.columns:
        raise KeyError("Both dataframes must contain an 'id' column.")

    merged = pd.merge(df1, df2, on="id", how="inner")

    if column1 not in merged.columns or column2 not in merged.columns:
        raise KeyError(
            f"Columns '{column1}' and/or '{column2}' were not found after merging."
        )

    contingency = pd.crosstab(merged[column1], merged[column2])

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    if contingency.empty:
        ax.axis("off")
        ax.text(
            0.5,
            0.5,
            "No data available for contingency table",
            ha="center",
            va="center",
        )
        p_value = float("nan")
    else:
        sns.heatmap(contingency, annot=True, fmt="d", cmap="Blues", ax=ax)
        ax.set_xlabel(column2)
        ax.set_ylabel(column1)
        ax.set_title(f"Contingency Table: {column1} vs {column2}")

        try:
            _, p_value, _, _ = chi2_contingency(contingency)
        except ValueError:
            p_value = float("nan")

    return p_value, ax
```
